question: Does a confident witness mean a reliable one?
answer: Only weakly — and confidence moves after the fact. Witnesses told they picked the right person become markedly more certain, and also recall a better view and a clearer memory. The confidence a jury hears in court has already been shaped by what happened after the identification.
move: Confidence in the witness box is partly manufactured after the event.
source: Wells & Bradfield, Journal of Applied Psychology, 1998
reference: Wells & Bradfield, Good, you identified the suspect: feedback to eyewitnesses distorts their reports of the witnessing experience, Journal of Applied Psychology, 1998
